question: Can a standalone native Qiskit QNN exploit the crop information shown by training-only classical representation diagnostics?
cv: Three previous fixed stratified training folds, random_state=2026, not spatial
preprocessing: StandardScaler -> full-SVD PCA -> StandardScaler, fitted within each training fold; optional SelectKBest(f_classif,k=4) fitted there too
topology: full, ordered lexicographic directed CX edges, two blocks and three RY banks; selected by previous training-only CV, not by validation
optimizer: Verified native L-BFGS-B with exact parameter-shift CE gradient
budget_interpretation: Same maximum objective/gradient calls, not equal elementary computation; 4q needs 25 probability passes per gradient, 6q needs 37
selection: Highest mean seed-specific pooled OOF macro-F1; exact ties favor fewer qubits then first4_q4. This is exploratory model selection on reused training folds, not an unbiased final performance estimate.
final_fit: Fit the training-selected candidate on all 914 training fields for seeds 0,1,2; save preprocessing and weights without any validation/test inference
reference_check: Fresh first4_q4 CV must match prior full-connectivity OOF predictions, metrics and final weights
width_confounders: number and ordering of CNOT gates
